title: Sell abroad
tagline: Foreign clients paid safely, in their currency, without the exchange-rate surprises.
trigger: Invoices are paid by clients in other countries, or a growing share of income arrives from abroad.

steps.title: Get paid in their currency
steps.description: A multi-currency business account: receive pounds, dollars or francs without converting every payment.
steps.why: Based on the foreign client payments already on your account. Nothing is shared.
steps.result: Multi-currency account opened. Foreign payments land in their own currency.

steps.title: Make sure a new foreign client pays
steps.description: For a first order from a client you don't know yet: a documentary credit or collection, or a bank guarantee.
steps.why: Chasing an unpaid invoice abroad is slow and expensive; a bank in between removes that risk.
steps.result: Export payment terms ready: a documentary collection for your next new client abroad.

steps.title: Fix the exchange rate
steps.description: Lock in the rate for invoices you'll be paid in the coming months, so the price you agreed is the price you get.
steps.why: Only worth it for large or regular foreign-currency payments; we show the numbers first.

win.customer: A known margin on every order

steps.result: Exchange-rate check done: a forward contract is proposed for your largest foreign client (illustrative).

steps.title: The sustainability data foreign buyers ask for
steps.description: Large European clients increasingly ask their suppliers for ESG figures. Kube ESG prepares them once, for every buyer.
steps.why: Kube ESG only receives your name, e-mail and company details, never your bank data.

win.customer: Pass the supplier check of big buyers

steps.result: Kube ESG profile ready: your first supplier questionnaire is pre-filled.

steps.title: An export plan with your relationship manager
steps.description: Which markets next, and Go&Deal Pro to meet vetted buyers and partners abroad.
steps.why: Your relationship manager gets the file KBC already built, so you never start from zero.
steps.result: Meeting booked with your relationship manager; Go&Deal Pro access requested.
